payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy algorithm to find lexicographically minimal beautiful string by incrementing characters from the right and filling the rest with smallest valid letters.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single greedy mechanism: it iterates from the end, attempts to increase a character, then greedily fills the suffix with the smallest characters satisfying the divisibility condition. No other algorithmic families like sorting or complete search are central; minor sorting is just a utility within the greedy step.
